name: collections: reads named the way an Illumina run names them become a paired collection
description: Sequencing facilities deliver reads as <sample>_S<n>_L<lane>_R1_001.fastq.gz, where the mate marker sits in the middle of the name rather than at the end. Four such files for two samples land loose. Graded on a list:paired collection of two elements with the compressed Sanger datatype; the exact identifiers are not graded, since liver and liver_S1_L001 both name the sample.
inputs: My current history has paired-end reads for two tissues straight from the sequencing facility. Group them into a paired collection called "reads". Go ahead and do it.

*.why: Galaxy's collection tools build lists and list:paired through run_tool (__BUILD_LIST__, __ZIP_COLLECTION__, __APPLY_RULES__).
